name: Dragon's Heart
source:
Paladin Dorian Burnham, known as the "Dragon of Gale" for his powerful fire channeling abilities, lived a seemingly perfect life until the Tragedy of Tianho claimed his entire family, leading him to abandon his powers and live a life in exile in the kingdom of Mjoll. Five years later, Dorian returns to Tianho and is forced to reawaken his fire powers during an assassination attempt on the life of the Emperor of Kyeongjang, Chung-hee, leading him to join forces with Yuxuan, Svante, and Niko to stop King Gustav's plot to seize control of Ena. 

Will Dorian and his companions succeed in thwarting King Gustav's plan? And can Dorian overcome his past and find love once more?
